 43 impl GpuBody {
 44     pub fn new(gpu: &ArmorGpu, surface: BodySurface) -> Result<Self, GenerateError> {
 45         let vertices = surface.positions.len();
 46         if vertices == 0
 47             || surface.normals.len() != vertices
 48             || surface.texcoords.len() != vertices
 49             || surface.joint_indices.len() != vertices
 50             || surface.joint_weights.len() != vertices
 51             || surface.joint_indices.joint_count() != surface.joints.joint_count()
 52             || surface
 53                 .faces
 54                 .iter()
 55                 .flatten()
 56                 .any(|i| *i as usize >= vertices)
 57         {
 58             return Err(GenerateError::InvalidSurface);
 59         }
 60         Ok(Self {
 61             positions: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(surface.positions))?,
 62             normals: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(surface.normals))?,
 63             faces: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(surface.faces))?,
 64             texcoords: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(surface.texcoords))?,
 65             joint_indices: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(
 66                 surface.joint_indices.native_words(),
 67             ))?,
 68             joint_weights: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(surface.joint_weights))?,
 69             joints: gpu.upload(BufferUpload::from_elements(
 70                 surface.joints.as_native_slice(),
 71             ))?,
 72             vertex_count: u32::try_from(vertices).map_err(|_| GenerateError::InvalidSurface)?,
 73             face_count: u32::try_from(surface.faces.len())
 74                 .map_err(|_| GenerateError::InvalidSurface)?,
 75             joint_count: surface.joints.joint_count(),
 76         })
 77     }

229         joint_indices: &fabelgeist_rig::PackedRigSkin<8>,

239             .joint_names

242                 RigJointMembership::from(owners.iter().any(|owner: &RigJointName| -> bool {

102     skin: &gltf::Skin<'_>,
103     blob: &[u8],
104 ) -> Result<fabelgeist_rig::RigJointTable<[f32; 8]>> {
105     Ok(skin
106         .reader(|_| Some(blob))

108         .context("bind poses")?
109         .map(|matrix| {
110             let (scale, rotation, p) = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&matrix)
111                 .inverse()
112                 .to_scale_rotation_translation();
113             [
114                 p.x, p.y, p.z, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, rotation.w, scale.x,
115             ]
116         })
117         .collect())

120 fn surface_chart(positions: &[[f32; 3]]) -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
121     let low = positions.iter().map(|p| p[1]).fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
122     let high = positions
123         .iter()
124         .map(|p| p[1])
125         .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
126     positions
127         .iter()
128         .map(|[x, y, z]| {
129             [
130                 x.atan2(*z) / std::f32::consts::TAU + 0.5,
131                 (y - low) / (high - low),
132             ]
133         })
134         .collect()
135 }

def main() -> int:
    repository = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="replace a mismatched cache")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--verify-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="verify the installed cache without downloading or replacing it",
    )
    corrective_mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    corrective_mode.add_argument(
        "--lod4-correctives",
        action="store_true",
        help="also install the LOD 4 corrective basis used by the default creator view",
    )
    corrective_mode.add_argument(
        "--all-correctives",
        action="store_true",
        help="also install the corrective bases for LODs 4, 5 and 6",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--destination",
        type=Path,
        default=repository / f"target/mhr-assets/v{VERSION}",
        help="cache root; extracted files are installed under its assets directory",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.destination.resolve()
    required_files = selected_files(args.lod4_correctives, args.all_correctives)
    if args.verify_only:
        destination = root / "assets"
        if not installed(destination, required_files):
            raise RuntimeError(f"MHR asset cache is missing or invalid at {destination}")
        print(f"Verified pinned MHR v{VERSION} assets at {destination}.")
    else:
        initialise(root, required_files, args.force)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except RuntimeError as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1) from error

traversal includes every original slot.

The dense matrix admits its joint-channel extent, complete element product and
native float allocation layout before allocation. Column extension and tensor
prefix transposition return errors for unrepresentable or invalid extents.
`NpyDimension` carries the model-column array extent through parameter tables
and MHR state until the native tensor boundary. `ModelParameterTable<f32>`
retains column roles without imposing a new scalar range or finite-value
policy.

## Corrective archive admission

`CorrectiveArchiveBytes` keeps activation and basis inputs in named fields
through URI loading and NumPy archive admission. It does not validate encoded
archive contents. Corrective import checks basis axes, mesh vertex count and
hidden-unit count before tensor construction. It admits joint subtraction and
tensor-extent products with checked arithmetic, then pairs the two sparse index
columns with their ordered weights. A mismatch returns `CorrectiveImportError`
through the loader's error context. Archive and NumPy causes remain available.

The private `CorrectiveLayout` owns the admitted `[components, vertices, 3]`
basis shape: components equal the hidden width and vertices equal the supplied
mesh count. `CorrectiveBasis` retains that layout with its array until upload.
Counts become generic array extents at this boundary; they do not certify rig
identity, mesh topology or geometry validity.

Sparse coordinates retain distinct `CorrectiveHiddenIndex` and
`CorrectiveFeatureIndex` roles after the native-width cast. Their native
projections support structured diagnostics without claiming membership. The
layout checks every coordinate before dense allocation. Admitted sparse
contributions retain checked offsets and borrow that layout; upload cannot
substitute another layout or repeat membership admission. Transposition,
coefficient order and last-write behavior for duplicates are preserved.

Corrective evaluation checks the input tensor's exact joint count and seven
channels before slicing or matrix operations. The admitted input retains the
network layout through rotation-feature extraction. Values must already use
the model's channel order; shape admission does not prove rig identity or
value provenance. `CorrectiveForwardError` distinguishes count and channel
mismatches and retains a concrete `NpyLayoutError` source for batch-dependent
layout overflow. No new finite-value or positive-batch restriction is imposed.

The corrective basis holds one float per component, vertex and coordinate.
Disabling correctives avoids loading that basis and the activation network.
Representable layout admission does not promise a memory budget or execution
of every empty layout supported by array storage.

pub const WEAPON_PRECISION_RAPIER: f32 = 2.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CharacterCapabilities {
    pub melee: bool,
    pub ranged: bool,
    pub weapon_precision: f32,
    pub heavy: bool,
    pub quarter_armor: bool,

    pub endurance: f32,

}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "spacetimedb", derive(spacetimedb::SpacetimeType))]
pub struct RoleRequirements {
    pub melee: bool,
    pub ranged: bool,
    pub weapon_precision: f32,
    pub heavy: bool,
    pub quarter_armor: bool,
    pub half_armor: bool,
    pub three_quarter_armor: bool,
    pub full_armor: bool,
    pub athletics: u8,
    pub endurance: u8,
    pub physiology: u8,
    pub surgery: u8,
    pub command: u8,
    pub religion: u8,
}

impl CharacterCapabilities {
    pub fn meets(self, requirements: RoleRequirements) -> bool {
        (!requirements.melee || self.melee)
            && (!requirements.ranged || self.ranged)
            && self.weapon_precision >= requirements.weapon_precision
            && (!requirements.heavy || self.heavy)
            && (!requirements.quarter_armor || self.quarter_armor)
            && (!requirements.half_armor || self.half_armor)
            && (!requirements.three_quarter_armor || self.three_quarter_armor)
            && (!requirements.full_armor || self.full_armor)

208: pub fn deposit(
209:     ctx: &ReducerContext,
210:     character_id: u64,
211:     substance: FilthSubstance,
212:     source_character_id: Option<u64>,
213:     amount: u16,
214:     at: StrategicMinute,
215: ) -> Result<Option<u64>, String> {
216:     let amount = filth::bounded_deposit_amount(total(ctx, character_id), amount);
217:     if amount == 0 {
218:         return Ok(None);
219:     }
220:     let row = ctx.db.character_filth().insert(CharacterFilth {
221:         id: 0,
222:         character_id,
223:         substance,
224:         origin: match source_character_id {
225:             Some(source) if source == character_id => FilthOrigin::Own,
226:             Some(_) => FilthOrigin::Foreign,
227:             None => FilthOrigin::Unknown,
228:         },
229:         amount,
230:         deposited_at: at,
231:     });
232:     ctx.db.filth_provenance().insert(FilthProvenance {
233:         filth_id: row.id,
234:         source_character_id,
235:     });
236:     if substance == FilthSubstance::Blood
237:         && let Some(source) = source_character_id
238:     {
239:         let immunity = ctx
240:             .db
241:             .character_attributes()
242:             .character_id()
243:             .find(source)
244:             .map_or(3.0, |attributes| attributes.immunity);
245:         let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
246:         for episode in ctx.db.infection_episode().character_id().filter(source) {
247:             let disease_id = episode
248:                 .disease_id
249:                 .parse::<DiseaseId>()
250:                 .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
251:             if !adventuresim_core::disease::definition(disease_id)
252:                 .supports(adventuresim_core::disease::TransmissionVector::Blood)
253:                 || episode.contracted_at > at
254:                 || matches!(
255:                     adventuresim_core::disease::evaluate(
256:                         adventuresim_core::disease::InfectionEpisode {
257:                             id: episode.id,
258:                             character_id: source,
259:                             disease_id,
260:                             contracted_at: episode.contracted_at,
261:                             ruleset_version: episode.ruleset_version,
262:                             phenotype_key_version: episode.phenotype_key_version,
263:                         },
264:                         at,
265:                         immunity,
266:                     )
267:                     .stage,
268:                     adventuresim_core::disease::DiseaseStage::Resolved
269:                 )
270:                 || !seen.insert((disease_id as u8, episode.id))
271:             {
272:                 continue;
273:             }
274:             ctx.db
275:                 .filth_disease_snapshot()
276:                 .insert(FilthDiseaseSnapshot {
277:                     id: 0,
278:                     filth_id: row.id,
279:                     disease_id: disease_id.stable_id().into(),
280:                     episode_id: episode.id,
281:                 });
282:         }
283:     }
284:     Ok(Some(row.id))
285: }

/// View of [`ConnectedPlayer`] for this [`TacticalServer`].
#[view(accessor = connected_players, public)]
pub fn connected_players(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<ConnectedPlayer> {
    ctx.db
        .character()
        .server()
        .filter(ctx.sender())
        .filter_map(|character| {
            let limbs = ctx.db.character_limbs().character_id().find(character.id)?;
            let attrs = ctx
                .db
                .character_attributes()
                .character_id()
                .find(character.id)?;
            let skills = ctx
                .db
                .character_skills()
                .character_id()
                .find(character.id)?;
            let stats = ctx.db.character_stats().character_id().find(character.id)?;
            let condition = ctx
                .db
                .character_condition()
                .character_id()
                .find(character.id)?;
            let strategic = ctx
                .db
                .character_strategic_condition()
                .character_id()
                .find(character.id)?;
            let items = connected_player_items(ctx, character.id).collect();

            let server = ctx
                .db
                .tactical_server_authority()
                .identity()
                .find(ctx.sender());
            let mission_side = server
                .as_ref()
                .filter(|server| server.enemy_character_ids.contains(&character.id))
                .map_or(TacticalMissionSide::Party, |_| TacticalMissionSide::Enemy);
            Some(ConnectedPlayer {
                character,
                mission_side,
                items,
                skills,
                limbs,
                attrs,
                stats,
                enemy_difficulty: server.as_ref().map_or(1, |server| server.enemy_difficulty),
                enemy_combat_scale_bps: server.as_ref().map_or(
                    u32::from(adventuresim_world_schema::BASIS_POINTS_PER_WHOLE),
                    |server| server.enemy_combat_scale_bps,
                ),
                countermeasure_multiplier_bps: server.as_ref().map_or(
                    u32::from(adventuresim_world_schema::BASIS_POINTS_PER_WHOLE),
                    |server| server.countermeasure_multiplier_bps,
                ),
                party_has_surprise: server
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|server| server.party_has_surprise),
                body_weight_kg: condition.body_weight_kg,
                current_blood_ml: condition.current_blood_ml,
                maximum_blood_ml: condition.maximum_blood_ml,
                strategic_incapacitation: strategic.incapacitation,
                strategic_pain: strategic.pain,
                strategic_blood_loss: strategic.blood_loss,
                strategic_fear: strategic.fear,
                strategic_fatigue: strategic.fatigue,
                strategic_hunger: strategic.hunger,
                strategic_thirst: strategic.thirst,
                strategic_thermal: strategic.thermal,
            })
        })
        .collect()
}

831: async fn social_npc_in_scope(
832:     state: &AppState,
833:     character_id: u64,
834:     settlement_id: &str,
835:     location_id: &str,
836:     resident_character_id: u64,
837: ) -> Result<BackendSettlementResident, StatusCode> {
838:     let character = state
839:         .db
840:         .query_one_sats_into::<adventuresim_stdb_client::Character, crate::spacetimedb::CharacterView>(
841:             &crate::spacetimedb::character_by_id(character_id),
842:         )
843:         .await
844:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?
845:         .ok_or(StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED)?;
846:     if character.current_settlement_id.as_deref() != Some(settlement_id) {
847:         return Err(StatusCode::FORBIDDEN);
848:     }
849:     let settlement = state
850:         .db
851:         .query_one_sats_into::<adventuresim_stdb_client::Settlement, SettlementView>(
852:             &crate::spacetimedb::settlement_by_id(settlement_id),
853:         )
854:         .await
855:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?
856:         .ok_or(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)?;
857:     if !npc_location_is_navigable(
858:         &settlement.economy,
859:         &settlement.category,
860:         settlement_id,
861:         location_id,
862:     ) {
863:         return Err(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
864:     }
865:     let npc = state
866:         .db
867:         .query_one_sats::<BackendSettlementResident>(
868:             &crate::spacetimedb::settlement_resident_by_character_id(resident_character_id),
869:         )
870:         .await
871:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?
872:         .filter(|npc| {
873:             npc.home_settlement_id == settlement_id
874:                 && npc_matches_location_binding(
875:                     npc,
876:                     settlement_id,
877:                     location_id,
878:                     &settlement.economy,
879:                 )
880:         })
881:         .ok_or(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)?;
882:     if !super::data::character_is_alive_as_observed(
883:         state,
884:         resident_character_id,
885:         character_id,
886:     )
887:     .await
888:     .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
889:         tracing::warn!(%error, resident_character_id, observer_character_id = character_id, "could not project resident life state");
890:         true
891:     }) {
892:         return Err(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
893:     }
894:     Ok(npc)
895: }

897: async fn available_social_npc(
898:     state: &AppState,
899:     character_id: u64,
900:     settlement_id: &str,
901:     location_id: &str,
902:     resident_character_id: u64,
903: ) -> Result<BackendSettlementResident, StatusCode> {
904:     let npc = social_npc_in_scope(
905:         state,
906:         character_id,
907:         settlement_id,
908:         location_id,
909:         resident_character_id,
910:     )
911:     .await?;
912:     let minute = state
913:         .db
914:         .query_one_sats::<CharacterTime>(&crate::spacetimedb::character_time_by_character_id(
915:             character_id,
916:         ))
917:         .await
918:         .ok()
919:         .flatten()
920:         .map_or(StrategicMinute::new(720), |t| calendar_minute(&t.minutes));
921:     let present = state
922:         .db
923:         .query_sats::<SettlementResidentPresence>(
924:             &crate::spacetimedb::settlement_resident_presence_by_character_id(
925:                 resident_character_id,
926:             ),
927:         )
928:         .await
929:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?
930:         .into_iter()
931:         .any(|presence| {
932:             presence.settlement_id == settlement_id
933:                 && presence.location_id == location_id
934:                 && npc_presence_contains(presence.start_minute, presence.end_minute, minute)
935:         });
936:     present.then_some(npc).ok_or(StatusCode::CONFLICT)
937: }

939: async fn npc_social_view(
940:     state: &AppState,
941:     character_id: u64,
942:     npc: BackendSettlementResident,
943:     last_outcome: Option<SocialChatOutcome>,
944: ) -> Result<NpcSocialView, StatusCode> {
945:     let relationship = state
946:         .db
947:         .query_one_sats::<BackendSettlementResidentRelationship>(&format!(
948:             "SELECT * FROM backend_settlement_resident_relationships WHERE observer_character_id = {character_id} AND resident_character_id = {}",
949:             npc.character_id

951:         .await
952:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?;
953:     let status = state
954:         .db
955:         .query_one_sats::<BackendCharacterRelationshipStatus>(
956:             &crate::spacetimedb::character_relationship_status_by_character_id(character_id),
957:         )
958:         .await
959:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?
960:         .filter(|status| status.character_id == character_id);
961:     let active_commitment = active_commitment_with(state, character_id, npc.character_id).await?;
962:     let actor_minute = state
963:         .db
964:         .query_one_sats::<CharacterTime>(&crate::spacetimedb::character_time_by_character_id(
965:             character_id,
966:         ))
967:         .await
968:         .map_err(|_| StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)?
969:         .map_or(StrategicMinute::ZERO, |t| calendar_minute(&t.minutes));
970:     let courting_this_npc = status
971:         .as_ref()
972:         .is_some_and(|status| status.courtship_partner_id == Some(npc.character_id));
973:     let mut romantic_actions = Vec::new();

}

/// Calculate authoritative economic and risk results for one settlement interval.
pub fn settlement_activity_outcome(
    schedule: DailySchedule,
    elapsed_minutes: u64,
    inputs: ActivityOutcomeInputs,
) -> ActivityOutcome {
    let days = elapsed_minutes as f32 / adventuresim_world_schema::calendar::MINUTES_PER_DAY as f32;
    let hours = |minutes: u16| days * f32::from(minutes) / 60.0;
    let labor_hours = hours(schedule.labor);
    let thievery_hours = hours(schedule.thievery);
    let raiding_hours = hours(schedule.raiding);
    let carousing_hours = hours(schedule.carousing_minutes);
    ActivityOutcome {
        gold_earned: labor_gold(labor_hours, inputs.strength_check, inputs.endurance_check)
            .saturating_add(thievery_gold(

287:     /// Registers a callback that is invoked when the previous [`Queue::submit`] finishes executing
288:     /// on the GPU. When this callback runs, all mapped-buffer callbacks registered for the same
289:     /// submission are guaranteed to have been called.
290:     ///
291:     /// For the callback to run, either [`queue.submit(..)`][q::s], [`instance.poll_all(..)`][i::p_a],
292:     /// or [`device.poll(..)`][d::p] must be called elsewhere in the runtime, possibly integrated into
293:     /// an event loop or run on a separate thread.
294:     ///
295:     /// The callback runs on the thread that first calls one of the above functions after the GPU work
296:     /// completes. There are no restrictions on the code you can run in the callback; however, on native

186:         .with_chord_interface(TowerChordInterface {
187:             toward_gate,
188:             bearing_depth: spec.chord_bearing,
189:         })
190:     };
191:     Some([make(left_centre, along), make(right_centre, against)])
192: }

1898:     """Seed a fresh standalone tactical mission against an already-running
1899:     isolated SpacetimeDB instance, without rebuilding or republishing the
1900:     module.
1901: 
1902:     `bootstrap_development_world` is idempotent (every fixture it seeds is
1903:     guarded by a find-before-insert check), so it's safe to call again on a
1904:     database that already has world data. `seed_standalone_tactical_mission`
1905:     is not safe to call twice with the same mission_id once a previous
1906:     mission has bound a tactical_server_authority row for it (it silently
1907:     no-ops rather than erroring, and a prior mission that never shut down
1908:     cleanly leaves that row orphaned forever) - so this always mints a fresh
1909:     randomized mission_id instead of reusing `mission_id_prefix` verbatim.
1910: 
1911:     `if_live=True` (used when this is an automatic step ahead of `just
1912:     tactical`, not a standalone user-facing call) makes a missing live
1913:     instance a silent no-op (exit 0) instead of an error, so it doesn't
1914:     block plain `cargo run`-style usage against a non-isolated database.
1915:     """
1916:     live = live_spacetime_for_profile(profile, base_port)
1917:     if live is None:

1923:             "to get a fresh mission against it without rebuilding/republishing the module.",
